versions.content: DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula that has more than one part The evaluation result of a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula with more than one part shall be calculated by combining the results of the part s with the logical Operation specified by DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula . op . The evaluation shall be done in a short-cut manner, i.e. following the rules for the evaluation of the logical operators in C. The consequences of this approach are: 79 of 577  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 673: AUTOSAR_TPS_DiagnosticExtractTemplate Diagnostic Extract Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 • The part s shall be evaluated in the specified order starting at the first element. This is why the aggregation of part is decorated by the ordered qualifier. • after the evaluation of each part a check shall be executed if it is still possible that the evaluation of the remaining part s (to true or false ) could change the overall result. • As soon as a change of the overall result is no longer possible, i.e. any of the following conditions evaluates to false :  there are no part s left  the current part was evaluated to false and DiagnosticEnvCon- ditionFormula . op == DiagnosticLogicalOperatorEnum . logica- lAnd  the current part was evaluated to true and DiagnosticEnvCondi- tionFormula . op == DiagnosticLogicalOperatorEnum . logicalOr the evaluation of the part s shall be finalized and the evaluation result of the current part shall be considered the overall evaluation result of the formula. Regarding the strategy for returning NRC values please refer to the specification of the SWS Dcm [10].
